verdict.rationale: Gram exposes tools via MCP servers to MCP-compatible clients (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex) but the evidence never mentions documented adapters or integrations for agent frameworks/SDKs like Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, or OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs.
